description.narrative: The project will contribute to (i) improving the quality of electricity supply services through the reduction of outages duration in Antioquia, (ii) increase access to electricity services through the expansion of EPM network in dense urban areas, and (iii) increasing EPM electricity supply resilience to climate-related vulnerabilities. Additionally, through the project, EPMs progress in grid automation and digitalization demonstrates how investment plans can be directed to reduce service interruptions and commercial losses in distribution companies across Colombia.

The proposed investment involves a US$600 million, 10-year unsecured corporate loan (UCL) to Empresas Públicas de Medellín (EPM or the Company) to finance upgrades and expansion of its power distribution network. The financing includes an A-Loan of up to US$250 million in and mobilization of up to US$350 million. This initiative will enhance access to reliable utility services for the more than 2.9 million of EPMs customers in Colombia.
